verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in AI assistant inside Pipedrive to which users can delegate tasks. The homepage line about managing deals 'with AI' is vague marketing and describes no assistant. The MCP server page ('all from your AI assistant') describes an external AI assistant connecting to Pipedrive, which belongs to a different MCP-server story and does not count as an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
